# NexRNN Technologies

> Digital marketing agency and technology solutions company based in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. Offers client services (Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, website development and more), practical training courses and workshops, and paid internship / job programs for students.

NexRNN Technologies helps businesses build, market, and grow their digital presence through Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, website development, branding, and related technology services. It also runs skill-focused training (courses and hands-on workshops) and offers internship / job openings where candidates apply online — paid applications are completed securely through the Cashfree payment gateway.

## Services

- Google Ads / PPC management
- Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) management
- Social Media Marketing and Management
- Google Business Profile (GMB) optimization and local SEO
- Website Development (business sites, landing pages, e-commerce, React, WordPress)
- Website Design (UI/UX)
- SEO (technical, on-page, local)
- Graphic Design and Branding
- Video Editing and AI Video Creation
- Brand Promotion and Digital Marketing Strategy

Full list with details: https://www.nexrnntechnologies.in/services

## Courses

- Digital Marketing — SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media, analytics, lead generation
- Artificial Intelligence — AI fundamentals, generative AI, prompt engineering, practical AI tools
- Website Development — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Git, deployment

Enrollment is batch-based with online payment (secure Cashfree checkout). Full list: https://www.nexrnntechnologies.in/course

## Workshops

- Hands-on, session-based training workshops on marketing and technology topics
- Each workshop has batch details, schedule and fee; enrollment with secure online payment

Full list: https://www.nexrnntechnologies.in/workshop

## Careers — Internships & Jobs

- Internship and job openings (when available) with details (domain, duration, stipend/fee, mode)
- Online application form with resume upload; paid openings complete payment via Cashfree
- Applicants receive an Application ID and confirmation with a downloadable application PDF
- Application forms open ONLY while positions are available — when there are no openings,
  the careers page shows a "not hiring" notice

Current openings and apply links: https://www.nexrnntechnologies.in/careers
